newsitem.title: CHINA: S.E. Asia Wood seen in HK$150-200 mln float.
newsitem.headline: S.E. Asia Wood seen in HK$150-200 mln float.

text.p: Hong Kong-based plywood maker South East Asia Wood Industry Holdings Ltd is expected to raise HK$150 million to HK$200 million in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares to be kicked off later in August, sources said.
South East Asia Wood is expected to issue about 150 million new shares, or 25 percent of its enlarged share capital, at a price to be fixed, market sources said.
HSBC Investment is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, they said.
The IPO is expected to run from August 26 to 29 and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on September 8, they said.
The company is expected to hold a presentation for analysts on Thursday and a press briefing next Monday, sources said.
South East Asia Wood is engaged in manufacturing plywood in timber-riched Laos. The company exports its plywood to nearby Thailand, China and some other Asian countries, sources said.
Sources said net proceeds to be raised from the issue would be used to buy new machinery upgrading its production facilities and expanding its operation in Laos.
